description: This file implements the Pause task class for a media player, providing functionality to pause media playback by changing the pipeline state and updating the context.

classes.name: Pause
classes.description: A class representing the pause operation in the media player task system.

methods.name: Pause::Pause
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Pause task with the given context and player interface.

methods.name: Pause::~Pause
methods.description: Destructor for the Pause class, logs when the pause operation is finished.

methods.name: Pause::execute
methods.description: Executes the pause operation by stopping position reporting, changing pipeline state to paused, and updating the context.
